decisions.reason: A large bulk container close to the core range costs little to keep, has its own page, and its value is still uncertain only one year after launch, so the option is worth holding.
The valve complements the bulk-container line at low carrying cost and still has unresolved upside, so keeping the option open is justified.

The take-back service fits the firm's move toward circular, service-based offerings, and although it is only mentioned on the website, its prospects are still uncertain and it costs little to maintain, so the option should be kept for now.
